response.sql: WITH driver_qualifying_counts AS (SELECT driverId, COUNT(*) as qualifying_count FROM qualifying GROUP BY driverId), avg_qualifying AS (SELECT AVG(CAST(qualifying_count AS FLOAT)) as avg_count FROM driver_qualifying_counts) SELECT dqc.driverId, dqc.qualifying_count, dqc.qualifying_count / aq.avg_count as ratio FROM driver_qualifying_counts dqc CROSS JOIN avg_qualifying aq ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10
